reviewed.note: core 0f1a350 (LOG.SET download, manifest only) checked again (#485, reported once more for the same reason); nibe 2.26.0 already reviewed.

unmapped.power: The F series reports no electrical power of the compressor; only the electric addition has a power coil (mapped as heater).
unmapped.heat: No heat output coil in the F series model files.
unmapped.volume: No flow rate coil on the exhaust air models; the card cannot estimate the heat output.
unmapped.defrost: A defrost is reported only as alarm 183 (alarm-45001), not as a state of its own; the alarm is excluded from the error chip.
unmapped.dhw_target: The water heater entity holds start and stop temperatures (target_temp_low, target_temp_high), no single target.
unmapped.hc_flow: BT2 is the supply of climate system 1 and already the heat pump flow; the card draws it as a direct circuit.
